channel.title: HiRISE: High Resolution Imaging Science Experiment (NASA)
channel.description: Updates from the HiRISE camera onboard the Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter (MRO/NASA). We are based at the University of Arizona in Tucson, Ariz.

item.title: HiPOD: Layers in Nili Fossae
item.description: These beautiful false color cutouts feature a series of layers in Nili Fossae, a scene also visible in Context Camera data. Nili Fossae has often been on the list for potential landing sites for robotic exploration, and will likely continue to be so given its rich landscape of mineral diversity. (NASA/JPL-Caltech/University of Arizona)
